## English

### Context

### Problem

### Proposed solution

### Scope / Scope pekerjaan

- [ ] P0 — stable contract or release blocker / kontrak stable atau release blocker
- [ ] P1 — important supported capability / kemampuan penting yang didukung
- [ ] P2 — enhancement or backlog candidate / enhancement atau kandidat backlog

### Acceptance criteria / Kriteria penerimaan

### Dependencies / Dependency

### Risks and false-positive considerations / Risiko dan pertimbangan false positive

### Security and privacy impact / Dampak security dan privacy

Explain network, subprocess, target-code execution, secret handling, filesystem, symlink, and report implications. / Jelaskan dampak terhadap network, subprocess, target-code execution, penanganan secret, filesystem, symlink, dan report.

### Fixture and regression-test plan / Rencana fixture dan regression test

### Compatibility and migration / Kompatibilitas dan migrasi

Explain changes to CLI commands, options, config, rule IDs, severities, exit codes, fingerprints, or report schemas. / Jelaskan perubahan pada command CLI, option, config, rule ID, severity, exit code, fingerprint, atau report schema.

### Alternatives considered / Alternatif yang dipertimbangkan

## Bahasa Indonesia

Gunakan bagian English di atas atau tulis jawaban setara dalam Bahasa Indonesia. Proposal yang baik memiliki context, problem, proposed solution, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, dan batas scope yang jelas. Jangan menyertakan secret, private key, isi `.env`, proprietary source, atau vulnerability yang belum ditambal. Untuk vulnerability, gunakan [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md), bukan Issue publik.
